==Description==
The '''Roblox Multipack - Cyber City''' is an official Roblox toy that was released in January of 2022. The toy offers the default Level 2 [[DJ Booth]], [[Medic]], default Level 5 [[Ranger]], [[Soul Boss]], [[Soul Stealer (Legacy)|Soul Stealer]] and Corruption. When you buy the toy, one redeemable code is given, which allows you to get the [https://www.roblox.com/bundles/815/Cyber-Angel Cyber Angel] bundle on Roblox. The toy is recommended for ages 6+ and is not suitable for children under 3 years old.

==Official Description==
*'''Online'''
*:The forces of destruction march on toward their ultimate goal, and it's up to you and your armies to stop them in Paradoxum Games' Tower Defense Simulator. Use your strength and cunning, along with the combined power of these unique defenses, to take down some of the most formidable enemies ever seen on Roblox!
*'''On Pack'''
*:The forces of destruction are on the move in Paradoxum Games' Tower Defense Simulator, and it's up to you and your armies to stop them. Strategize with these unique defenses to destroy the most deadly enemies ever seen!

==Prices & Stores==
Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. Generally, it costs around $19.99-$68.76 in the US, £21.99-£51.92 in the UK and €61.83 in the EU.

The stores in which you can buy the '''Roblox Multipack - Cyber City''' depends on country. The toy is subject to availability.

==Trivia==
*The Corruption enemy that comes with the '''Roblox Multipack - Cyber City''' does not appear in the game.
**This is because the toy is based on the final boss enemy intended for the [[2021 PVP Maps|2021 PVP]], which was leaked by Roblox in this pack.
**The broadsword it wields is similar to the one used by the [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]], however the enemy looks similar to the [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]].
**The enemy would later make an appearance in the Halloween 2025 event lobby.
*Despite [[Cyber City]] not being a [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode map when this toy was made, the [[Soul Boss]] and [[Soul Stealer (Legacy)|Soul Stealer]] appear in this toy.
**The [[Soul Boss]] is also improperly called a [[Soul]].
*The [[Medic]] has an entirely different appearance than the one in the game with any skin.
**The [[Medic]] in the toy was most likely based on the appearance of the unreleased [[Medic]] rework.
***The [https://www.roblox.com/bundles/815/Cyber-Angel Cyber Angel], which is a bundle that comes from this toy, appears to also be based on it, with some differences.
